aboutH2: Into Action Recovery Burnaby: Private Men's Rehab Near Metrotown
intro: Into Action Recovery Burnaby is the private, smaller house in Into Action's network of men's recovery homes in the Lower Mainland. It sits on Marine Drive in south Burnaby, a short trip from Metrotown, and offers 30, 60 or 90-day residential stays for men with alcohol or drug addiction.

It has the highest Google rating of any Into Action location, 5.0 from 64 reviews when we checked. Into Action describes higher-end amenities and smaller groups here, and the house has its own gym, a program room and a large kitchen.

pillars.title: A Quieter House on a Treed Lot
pillars.body: The Burnaby house is a long two-storey home under tall evergreens, with a wide paved driveway. Inside it is newer and better finished than most recovery houses: a white kitchen with a commercial glass-door fridge, a carpeted program room with whiteboards and wall screens, and simple bedrooms with big windows. With fewer men in the house, there is no hiding at the back of a group.

pillars.title: Counselling, Groups and Training
pillars.body: Men wake to a fixed schedule. There is individual counselling and group therapy with Into Action's team, step work and recovery assignments. The house has its own gym, and recovery.com lists yoga, adventure outings and movie nights. Staff take residents to AA, NA and other recovery meetings in the community.

pillars.title: Second Stage, Then Alumni
pillars.body: After the residential phase, men can move to Into Action's second-stage housing, where they keep a curfew, attend meetings and see a counsellor on site each week while they return to work or school. recovery.com adds outpatient support, online aftercare, aftercare groups and alumni reunions for this location, so ask admissions which of these apply to you.

overviewH2: Into Action Recovery Burnaby: Centre Overview
overview: Burnaby suits men who want Into Action's structure in a smaller, more comfortable house and who can pay privately. It treats alcohol and drug addiction, including opioids, fentanyl, cocaine, benzodiazepines and prescription drugs. Detox, psychiatry and prescribing all stay outside the house.

location.heading: Into Action Recovery Burnaby in Burnaby, British Columbia
location.intro: The house is on Marine Drive in south Burnaby, a few minutes from Metrotown and its SkyTrain station, in the middle of Metro Vancouver. Downtown Vancouver is about 25 minutes away by car, New Westminster about 10 minutes, Richmond and Vancouver International Airport around 25 minutes, Surrey about 25 minutes, and Victoria roughly three hours including the Swartz Bay to Tsawwassen ferry.

faqIntro: Answers come from Into Action's own website and public listings. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How is the Burnaby house different from Into Action's other locations?
faqs.a: Burnaby is Into Action's private program. The centre says it has higher-end amenities, smaller capacity and smaller groups than its other houses, so there is more individual attention. The core program of counselling, groups and step work is the same.

faqs.q: How much does Into Action Recovery Burnaby cost?
faqs.a: Into Action does not publish a price for Burnaby. It says the cost depends on whether you choose 30, 60 or 90 days, that admissions gives a transparent figure on the first call, and that it can help explore financing. Neither the centre nor recovery.com lists a dollar figure for this house.

faqs.q: How long is the program in Burnaby?
faqs.a: You can stay 30, 60 or 90 days. The clinical team recommends a length during admission based on your history and goals, and Into Action says many men do better with a longer stay.

faqs.q: Where is Into Action Recovery Burnaby?
faqs.a: It is at 6293 Marine Drive in south Burnaby, a few minutes from Metrotown SkyTrain station. Downtown Vancouver is about 25 minutes by car, New Westminster about 10, and Vancouver International Airport around 25 minutes for men flying in.

Usually, yes. Into Action says its private Burnaby program offers immediate admission compared with publicly funded beds, and that most men are admitted within days of the first call once detox, if needed, is done.

faqs.q: Is there medical care or detox at the Burnaby house?
faqs.a: No. Into Action is not a medical facility and has no doctors or nurses on site. Detox has to be completed elsewhere before admission, and residents get medical and medication support through a partnered virtual provider or their own doctor.

faqs.q: Does the Burnaby program treat anxiety or depression?
faqs.a: Into Action says it does not treat mental health conditions directly. recovery.com lists anger, anxiety, codependency and depression for this house, but the centre's own FAQ says it supports each man's existing mental health plan rather than providing that care itself.

faqs.q: What happens after the Burnaby program?
faqs.a: Men can move into Into Action's second-stage housing for continued structure while they return to work or school. recovery.com also lists outpatient treatment, online aftercare, aftercare group therapy and alumni reunions for this location.

faqs.q: Why is the Burnaby program men only?
faqs.a: Into Action has worked only with men since 2012. It says a men-only house removes social distractions and makes it easier to have direct, honest conversations and hold each other accountable.

faqs.q: Do men come to Burnaby from outside BC?
faqs.a: Yes. Into Action says men have come to its Burnaby house from Vancouver Island, the BC Interior, Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Washington State and Montana. Admissions can help coordinate travel.
